items.text: The following issue has been confirmed: Error screen after launching "Yu-Gi-Oh! MASTER DUEL"
To fix this issue, please update your Steam client to the latest version.
We apologize for any inconvenience caused by this issue.
Thank you for playing "Yu-Gi-Oh! MASTER DUEL."
